description: This file contains schema validation functions for localization JSON files, including functions to flatten nested objects, check for missing or extraneous keys, validate non-empty values, and perform schema validation across multiple languages. It also imports schemas and configuration data, and defines validation routines for different JSON files related to internationalization.

methods.name: flattenAnObject
methods.description: Recursively flattens a nested object into a single-level object with dot-separated keys.

methods.name: findMissingKeys
methods.description: Checks for missing keys in a translation object compared to a schema.

methods.name: findExtraneousKeys
methods.description: Checks for keys in a translation object that are not present in the schema.

methods.name: noEmptyObjectValues
methods.description: Validates that all values in an object (including nested objects) are non-empty.

methods.name: translationSchemaValidation
methods.description: Validates translation JSON files for each language.

methods.name: motivationSchemaValidation
methods.description: Validates motivation JSON files for each language.

methods.name: introSchemaValidation
methods.description: Validates intro JSON files for each language.

methods.name: metaTagsSchemaValidation
methods.description: Validates meta-tags JSON files for each language.

methods.name: linksSchemaValidation
methods.description: Validates links JSON files for each language.

methods.name: schemaValidation
methods.description: Performs comprehensive validation on a JSON file, including key presence, extraneous keys, non-empty values, and specific format checks for motivation quotes.

methods.name: readJsonFile
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON file from the locales directory for a given language and filename.
